title: xometry_lathe_sample_v3.0 (1)
general_tolerance_note: DIN ISO 2768-medium; deburr & break sharp edges 0.1...0.3 mm; general surface finish 3.2; scratches and dents are not acceptable

main shaft diameter

fillet radius at the right-hand step

mid-section axial length (chain dim under 104)
right-section axial length (chain dim under 104)

secondary overall length reference
right shaft step length
short length near the flange (lower chain)
short length near the flange (lower chain)
2×45 chamfer at the flange end

M5 internal thread on the right shaft end (with depth callout)
tapped depth of the M5 thread
keyway width on the main view, ISO tolerance class P9

scoring.match_rule: An LLM-extracted dimension matches a GT entry if (a) kind matches OR is a compatible alias, (b) numerical value within ±0.05 (mm precision), (c) tolerances within ±0.05 if specified. Compound annotations like 'M5 ▽ 12' are split into two GT entries (thread + length); the model gets credit for either one independently. ISO tolerance classes (h7, h8, P9) are recorded in 'as_drawn' but are not required for a numerical match.
scoring.passing_threshold: Strong = recall and precision >= 0.85; Pass = both >= 0.70.
